risk_description: If the model over-estimates shelf life of a perishable item then a member may eat spoiled food
consequence: Food poisoning and loss of trust in the app
control: High-risk categories always use the fixed conservative rule date; items with confidence below 0.70 labelled Check before use; app never shows the word safe; printed date always overrides the AI
evidence: Unit tests for AC-02 and AC-04; weekly spoiled-early rate per category in the ARCH-08 report

risk_description: If recipe suggestions ignore a member allergen then an unsafe recipe may be cooked
control: Allergen filter in the rule engine removes any recipe containing a profile allergen before display; allergen profile required at sign-up
evidence: AC-06 test result on 30 recipes with 0 peanut recipes shown

risk_description: If the OCR service misreads or cannot match receipt lines then wrong items enter the inventory
consequence: Wrong use-first list and corrupted training data
control: Unmatched lines go to a Needs label list; planner confirms all extracted items (H1); no unconfirmed item enters the inventory
evidence: QS-03 test on 20 own receipts (at least 90% matched) and count of unconfirmed items in the inventory = 0

risk_description: If members stop logging used or discarded items then the model learns from incomplete data
affected_stakeholder: S1 Grocery planner and S3 App maintainer
consequence: Inaccurate estimates and quantities; target not met
control: 2-tap logging (AC-05); weekly report shows logging coverage; items past date with no event prompt the member
evidence: Weekly logging-coverage figure in the ARCH-08 report (target at least 80% of items closed with an event)

risk_description: If receipt photos or purchase data are stored or shared then household privacy is exposed
affected_stakeholder: S1 Grocery planner and S2 Household members
consequence: Exposure of spending habits and partial card details
control: Photo deleted within 1 minute after extraction; only item / quantity / price / date stored; household-only access
evidence: QS-04 audit after 24 hours showing 0 stored images and 0 card digits

risk_description: If the quantity model suggests too much or too little then the household over-buys or runs short
consequence: More waste or extra shopping trips
control: Suggestions shown only after 4 weeks of history; planner approves every quantity (H3); items in stock with 3 or more days left shown as Already have
evidence: AC-03 test and weekly duplicate-purchase count = 0

risk_description: If the reminder fails to arrive then forgotten food spoils as before
affected_stakeholder: S1 Grocery planner and S2 Household members
control: Retry every 15 minutes for 2 hours and in-app banner fallback
evidence: QS-02 delivery log (at least 29 of 30 days on time)
